title: Hojin Ko Wins Outstanding Poster Award at KMS 2026
subtitle: Hojin Ko recognized for his poster on latent no-action region recovery in neural control.

sections.text: Hojin Ko received an Outstanding Poster Award at the 2026 Korean Mathematical Society (KMS) Fall Meeting, held at Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology (GIST) from October 29 to 31. His award-winning poster was titled “Knowing When Not to Act: Latent No-Action Region Recovery Hidden in Neural Control.”

sections.text: Hojin also gave a presentation on his award-winning poster. Congratulations to Hojin on this achievement! 👏
